column1: # What is eaten: the nouns that tell the verb jé "eats" (jésti jém, SSKJ²,
# SP 2001: long close e) from the auxiliary je "is" (bíti; unstressed, and
# stressed jè, short open e) when one of them follows je as its object (On
# je krompir, Ona je palačinke, On je veliko sadja). One lemma per line,
# chosen by hand; read by tools/formant/slovenian_words.py, which writes
# every Sloleks 3.1 form of the lemma with its cases (nominative,
# accusative, genitive) into SLOVENIAN_FOOD of formant_slovenian.inc, so
# that je_reading() in formant_slovenian.cpp can tell an unambiguous
# accusative (juho, hrano, palačinko) from a form that is the nominative
# too (krompir, meso, palačinke), which needs an eater as the subject.
# Sources: the collocations of jesti in Kolokacije of CJVT
# + samostalnik v rodilniku"), the examples of SSKJ² under jésti, the
# objects of je "eats" in SUK 1.1, and a listener's own examples of
# 2026-11-03 (krompir, palačinke). No drinks (one drinks them, pije), and
# no noun that is also a preposition or another common word (med "honey"
# is the preposition in je med njimi; rak the illness; plod and sadež, the
# fruit of an effort: roman je plod študija, 2 of 2 in SUK 1.1).
# Kolokacije: NE + JESTI + samostalnik v rodilniku
# SSKJ² jésti: jabolko, juha, večerja, kompot
